generated_at_is_not_freshness_law: Per FROZEN SPEC: generated_at is NEVER freshness. Every row below reads its as_of/observed_time/valid_time from artifact CONTENT (a belief_time, published_at, snapshot_date, or dated history file), never from filesystem mtime or a build script's own timestamp.

Edge rows DO carry valid_from/valid_to/era/evidence_time/belief_time columns (a bi-temporal SCHEMA), but the store keeps only the latest belief -- there is no historical parts directory to reconstruct 'what the crosswalk said on date X' except via the partial append-only log at data/theme_graph/probation/proposals.jsonl (234 dated proposal events, kind='mapping' among others -- NOT a full historical mirror of the frame).

canonical_theme_crosswalk.generated_at_is_not_freshness_note: computed_at (2026-08-15T02:32:47Z) is a BUILD timestamp, not a knowledge-time; belief_time (2026-08-15) is used instead per NULL LAW.

curated_baskets.pit_class_basis: membership_history.parquet carries per-member added/removed DATE fields going back to the seed_constant 2023-05-09 (1038 rows), letting membership at any past date be reconstructed as {added <= date < removed}. Only ONE dated full snapshots/ file exists (2026-08-13.json) -- so this is reconstruction from event dates, not an observed daily series (would be FULL_PIT/OBSERVED_PIT if daily snapshots existed).
curated_baskets.correction_behavior: curated by operator edits to membership.json; membership_history.parquet is append-style with a members_sha hash per snapshot for change detection
curated_baskets.pit_class_degraded_note: DEGRADED (adversarial review H3, verified against data/baskets/membership_history.parquet): 95% of 'added' dates across the 1038-row history are the single 2023-05-09 curator seed constant -- i.e. the reconstruction has almost no real temporal resolution before that date, and even after it, per-member add events are rarely individually dated. Removals are largely UNSTAMPED: the verified GOLD removal from basket:baskets:gold_miners (data/baskets/membership.json's live 'omitted' list correctly excludes GOLD, citing PR #5632) has NO corresponding 'removed' date anywhere in membership_history.parquet (GOLD still shows removed=NaN in the 2026-08-13 snapshot row) -- the removal is real and dated in the human-readable PR record but is NOT captured in the machine-readable PIT artifact. Treat RECONSTRUCTED_PIT here as coarse/seed-dominated, not a fine-grained daily reconstruction.
